highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and expands GTK4, Tizen, and .NET 11 support.
highlights_body: The release restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and adds GTK4 OpenGL drawing support with high-DPI scaling.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m156 and incorporates the m155 core fork cleanup.
Adds GTK4 OpenGL drawing integration and high-DPI-aware rendering for applications using SkiaSharp.Views.Gtk4.
Restores system-font discovery on Linux for applications that use the NoDependencies native assets.
Aligns WebAssembly native-asset packaging and package-consumer validation with the .NET 11 preview toolchain.
Updates the Tizen native build and package configuration for Tizen 10 with GCC 14.2.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments
